landing.headline: Smart Farming Starts with Healthy Plants
landing.subtitle: Detect plant diseases instantly using AI-powered technology.
landing.badge: AI for Indian farmers · Hindi & English
landing.featuresSubtitle: From a single leaf photo to a clear action plan.
landing.f1d: Upload or click a leaf photo and get the disease name with a confidence score.
landing.f2d: Use your phone camera directly in the field – no app install needed.
landing.f3d: Symptoms, causes, prevention and safe treatment guidance for every disease.
landing.f4d: Simple, farmer-friendly language. Switch any time.
landing.f5d: Every scan is saved so you can track your crop health over time.
landing.f6d: Download a diagnosis report to share with your agriculture officer.
landing.s1d: Click a clear photo of one affected leaf in daylight.
landing.s2d: Our trained model checks the leaf for 27 crop conditions.
landing.s3d: See the disease, confidence and what to do next.
landing.s4d: Follow prevention tips, consult an expert, download the report.
landing.cropsSubtitle: Trained on the PlantVillage dataset for these six crops.
landing.aboutText: Crop Care AI is a B.Tech final-year project that uses deep learning (MobileNetV2 transfer learning) to help farmers identify plant diseases early. It gives guidance only – always consult your local agriculture expert or Krishi Vigyan Kendra before using any chemical.
landing.footerProject: B.Tech Final Year Project · AI/ML + Full-Stack
